_comment: LANE-OWNED pins of the qwen-seedrep-native-battery lane (W3, launch F-B): the S5 multi-turn window probe's two LoRA-difference dose children
keyed by STAGED id the way the shared configs/sdfbase_full22_pins.json is; read as --peer-pins by scripts/modal/seedrep_launch_plan.py
beside configs/sdfbase_full22_roster_seedrep_probe_eb64_s1.yaml, and as --pins by make_bank_view.py (string form: object.pt under
<lane bank>/cells/<staged id> re-hashed EQUAL to object_sha256).
WHY A PRIVATE FILE: a peer lane's stager precheck is record-set equality on the shared pins file; nothing is appended to any shared surface.
Parent: derived_base64s1__constv2-mix-full__lora_r4_ce_minus_ctl (the lane's admitted LoRA difference, sha 0d275f7c76cb...); each child is
the parent's write bases B_pos / B_neg x dose per layer (scripts/sdfbase/scale_lora_dose.py; derived_meta.json records the verification).
object_sha256 = sha256(object.pt) measured on the grading host lane bank 2026-09-18 ($STAGE/sdfbase/full22_objects/qwen35_4b/cells/<staged id>/object.pt),
EQUAL to the shas the strength lane reported (lp.S5_PROBE_CELLS / lp.DOSE_CHILD_SHA; the plan refuses a disagreeing pin).

d1p5_eb64s1__constv2-mix-full__lora_r4_c.role: the stressing end (hardest-refusing; Crescendo backtracks buy the most turns)

dm0p5_eb64s1__constv2-mix-full__lora_r4_.role: the other end (terminates earlier); the pair gives the direction of the dose effect on context length
